devdoc.details: Blockchain-based voting system for academic project Features: - Multiple elections support - One vote per voter per election - Immutable vote records - Admin-only election creation - Transparent vote counting

castVote(uint256,uint256).details: Cast a vote in an election

constructor.details: Sets the contract deployer as admin

getAllCandidates(uint256).details: Get all candidates for an election

hasVoterVoted(uint256,address).details: Check if voter has voted in an election

 @dev Blockchain-based voting system for academic project

 - Multiple elections support
 - One vote per voter per election
 - Immutable vote records
 - Admin-only election creation
 - Transparent vote counting
